issue_context.summary: Investigate updater identity and installation scope across elevation
inferences: The proposed mechanism is provisional and is not an executed runtime result or evidence that the old report is fixed.
known_information: The0.81.1report describes a normal-user instance updated using an elevated account, followed by disappearing update UI and the old version remaining.
The report already identifies the account/elevation transition but has no installation-scope or completed-installer result.
Restarting repeatedly did not resolve the reported state; another generic run-as-administrator instruction would repeat the failing workflow.
issue_context.analysis: An update launched with different administrator credentials can cross account and per-user/per-machine installation boundaries. Determine the actual caller, installer target and restarted binary before choosing a scope or relaunch fix; no particular identity bug is proven.

steps: Use test accounts A and administrator B with a documented per-user installation for A; start the old-version runner as A.
